shots.text: Over Highwind, Kaela Stormrider brought Vholt's bird down with her own lance. She was the Galeborn's war-leader, and he had taught her to ride. For eleven days she had fought his army alone, falling back from camp to camp.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The black thunderbird crashing on the ridge at Highwind. Kaela on her grey stallion Thunderclap, lightning lance crackling, white war-paint across her face.

shots.text:
Kaela... someone I trusted asked me to go to the Rift. So I went. I'm sorry, girl.

Finish it. Clean, the way I taught you.
shots.speaker: vholt
shots.art_note: Vholt crawling free of the wreck, the grey light flickering out of his eyes as he looks up at Kaela and her lance.

shots.text: She finished it facing him, the way he taught her.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Kaela standing over the fallen warchief, lance lowered, rain starting.

shots.text: Eleven days I rode away from his army. I hate riding away. Point me at the next one.
shots.speaker: kaela
shots.art_note: Kaela reining in beside the player's towers, looking back at Highwind. Joins as a hero.
